The Offer

Check your Chase Offers for the following deal:

  • Earn $100 cash back on your Chase Travel purchase when you spend $600 or more, including taxes and after any discounts.

The Fine Print

  • Offer expires 10/31/2024.
  • Offer valid one time only.
  • Offer only valid on purchases made directly at chasetravel.com.
  • Offer valid online only.
  • Offer not valid on purchases made using third-party services or a third-party payment account (e.g., buy now pay later).
  • Complete payment for your Chase Travel purchase must be made by 10/31/2024.

Our Verdict

Less complicated version of the Ultimate Rewards offer we posted about yesterday.

Hat tip to reader Fin
